interpretations: Group matched tracks by media type name; calculate each name’s average of its nonmissing per-track `Bytes / Milliseconds` ratios and its total matched-track count; show names whose rate exceeds the unweighted mean of those name-level rates, with the unrounded rate and difference

Calculate the rate and total matched-track count separately for each media type record, even if records share a name; compare each record’s rate with the unweighted mean of all record-level rates, then show qualifying records’ names, unrounded rates, counts, and differences
queries:
WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT
    m.Name,
    AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType AS m
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.Name
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
  r.Name,
  r.rate,
  r.track_count,
  r.rate - mean_rate.rate AS difference
FROM media_rates AS r
CROSS JOIN mean_rate
WHERE r.rate > mean_rate.rate

WITH media_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.MediaTypeId,
        m.Name,
        COUNT(t.TrackId) AS matched_track_count,
        COUNT(t.TrackId) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track), 0) AS rate
    FROM MediaType AS m
    LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
mean_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS value
    FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
    mr.Name,
    mr.rate,
    mr.matched_track_count,
    mr.rate - mean_rate.value AS difference
FROM media_rates AS mr
CROSS JOIN mean_rate
WHERE mr.rate > mean_rate.value
